name: Ajax 1971/72-1972/73 (Ștefan Kovács)
scopeNote: Ajax under Ștefan Kovács from the first competitive match of 1971/72 (Twente 0-2 Ajax, Eredivisie, 15 Aug 1971 per Wikipedia season page) to the 1973 European Cup final (30 May 1973). Includes the European Cups of 1972 (2-0 Inter) and 1973 (1-0 Juventus). Style named 'Total Football' (totaalvoetbal); Michels' 1969-71 Ajax and the 1974 Netherlands are excluded: the 1971 final (Panathinaikos) is under Michels. Kovács' appointment is June 1971 per a secondary source, not a competitive match. Several sources (Vasović) argue Kovács merely continued Michels' system; tactical material dated strictly 1971-73 is thin and mostly rests on the StatsBomb 1972 final analysis, so most dimensions rely on one match.
openQuestions: Kovács' exact appointment date (June 1971 per secondary source) and the first competitive match date were taken from the Wikipedia season page, not a tier A-B source.

How much of the system was Kovács' own versus Michels' (Vasović: 'had nothing to do'; Wilson: freedom/decadence). No source found on zonal vs man-marking for 1971-73 beyond the offside trap and Neeskens' close attention to Mazzola in one match.
Tactical detail for 1972/73 league and the Bayern/Real Madrid ties comes only from one TFT article; Hungarian interview quote is undated, c.1973 likely.
statedView dates are the dates of the article where the quote was found; original dates of the Cruyff, Kovács and Vasović statements were not located (earliest appearance unknown).
